_comment: Source-controlled connection IDs for binding test/debug semantic models.
Add a model that shares an existing source: drop in a new entry with 'uses'.
Add a new shared source: register an alias under _connections.
When a model is deployed as a throwaway (DEBUG_UnitTest_<ENV>_*) or persistent debug
(DEBUG_<ENV>_*) copy, we bind the env-appropriate connection IDs explicitly
instead of doing a cross-workspace lookup against the upstream env's source model.
Why explicit IDs (not lookup): the PR-validation service principal
has 'Use' permission on prod connections (so it can bind them and refresh through them)
but does NOT have read access to the prod Insights workspace (so it cannot list the
prod model's connections). Hardcoding the IDs sidesteps this entirely.
